fusions.name: Snatch and Run
fusions.desc: Snatches at the target for 9 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Ricochet Toy
fusions.desc: Bounces a toy off the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then on to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Untie the Knots
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from the ally who needs it most.

fusions.name: Second Try
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
